title: Atlassian - Jira Users Receiving HTTP 500 Errors
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: Jira Users Receiving HTTP 500 Errors
Status: resolved
Impact: major
Started: 2019-05-10T14:10:29.123Z
Resolved: 2019-05-10T14:37:03.785Z
Updates:
- 2019-05-10T14:37:03.785Z: resolved - Between 13:30 UTC to 14:05 UTC, we experienced a partial service outage in the US region for Jira Cloud products. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.
- 2019-05-10T14:10:29.186Z: investigating - We are investigating an issue with Jira Cloud that is impacting some of our Atlassian Cloud customers. We will provide more details within the next hour.

incident_updates.body: Between 13:30 UTC to 14:05 UTC, we experienced a partial service outage in the US region for Jira Cloud products. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.
We are investigating an issue with Jira Cloud that is impacting some of our Atlassian Cloud customers. We will provide more details within the next hour.
